justification: Consolidation P1: wires the live ePlanning dual-occupancy prohibition gate (layer 452) into the capacity ceiling, which changes the displayed dwelling-yield ceiling. Previously the gate was fetched (frontend) but never consumed by the brief, so a lot where dual occupancy is prohibited still showed a dual-occ ceiling. This affects user-facing yield, so critical tier.

pre_impl.existing_data: portal_constraints.fetch_dual_occ_prohibition(lat,lng) already queries ePlanning layer 452 (Planning_Portal_Local_Provisions) and returns {prohibited: bool, epi_name, lga_name} or None on failure. It was unused by the capacity engine. The ceiling is computed by _ceiling_within_tier over the zone-tier ladder intersected with lep_land_use_table permitted forms.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: GATE-1pt2 assumed the densest permitted form (bounded by the zone tier) was the realistic ceiling, ignoring lot-specific prohibitions. A lot inside a dual-occupancy prohibition area would still surface dual_occupancy as the R2 ceiling.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new data, no schema change, no new file. Reuses the existing fetch_dual_occ_prohibition function. New helper _eligibility_excluded_forms(lat,lng) returns the engine forms to drop; _ceiling_within_tier and _realistic_forms gained an optional excluded_forms param; both brief assembly paths now compute and pass it. Heritage is already handled (GATE-2); the 776 low/mid-rise exclusion has no ceiling effect until LMR uplift (P2), so it is intentionally not called here.
pre_impl.external_source_error: fetch_dual_occ_prohibition returns None on ArcGIS failure. _eligibility_excluded_forms wraps the call in try/except and returns an EMPTY set on None / exception / missing coordinates — so a transient gov-API failure never over-restricts the ceiling (fails open to the base zone-tier ceiling).
pre_impl.frontend_type: Backend only. The capacity ceiling fields (max_permitted_form/dwellings) keep their types; only their value changes when a prohibition genuinely applies. No frontend interface change.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: a dual-occ-prohibited lot showed a 2-dwelling dual-occ ceiling the lot cannot legally achieve (over-report). After: dual_occupancy is dropped from the ceiling for that lot (R2 tops out at dwelling_house). The gate can only REMOVE a prohibited form, never add one; on query failure it changes nothing.

functions.name: _eligibility_excluded_forms
functions.input: lat, lng floats (or None) for the subject lot
functions.output: set of engine dev_type forms to exclude from the ceiling (e.g. {'dual_occupancy'})
functions.if_none: missing coords / None gate / exception -> empty set (ceiling unchanged, fail-safe)

functions.name: _ceiling_within_tier
functions.input: zone code, permitted engine forms, optional excluded_forms set
functions.output: densest permitted form at/below the zone tier that is NOT excluded

functions.name: _realistic_forms
functions.input: zone code, lga name, optional excluded_forms set

values: N/A - no regulatory values hardcoded. The prohibition is read live from ePlanning layer 452; the excluded form name ('dual_occupancy') is an engine dev_type identifier, not a planning value.
queries: N/A - no SQL added. The only new external call is the existing live ArcGIS point query (layer 452) via fetch_dual_occ_prohibition, read-only, already timeout-bounded and fail-open.

break_it.scenario: An R2 lot inside a dual-occupancy prohibition area (ePlanning 452 returns prohibited)
break_it.what_happens: Before, the ceiling was dual_occupancy (2 dwellings) the lot cannot achieve
break_it.how: _eligibility_excluded_forms adds 'dual_occupancy'; _ceiling_within_tier skips it -> ceiling drops to dwelling_house

break_it.scenario: The 452 query fails (ArcGIS down/timeout) or returns None
break_it.what_happens: A naive gate could over-restrict (drop forms) or crash the brief
break_it.how: try/except returns an empty set -> ceiling unchanged; the brief never blocks on the gate

break_it.scenario: A lot where dual occupancy is permitted (452 not in prohibition area)
break_it.what_happens: Over-tightening would wrongly drop a legitimate dual-occ ceiling
break_it.repro: pytest tests/test_eligibility_gates.py::test_dual_occ_not_prohibited_excludes_nothing ; live 17 Corden Ave -> ceiling stays 2 dual_occupancy
break_it.how: prohibited=False -> empty exclusion set; verified live the Five Dock ceiling stays dual_occupancy

break_it.scenario: Excluding a form that is not the ceiling form (e.g. dual_occ excluded on an R3 lot whose ceiling is multi_dwelling)
break_it.what_happens: An over-broad exclusion could wrongly lower an unrelated ceiling
break_it.how: the ladder walk only skips the excluded form; the R3 multi_dwelling ceiling is unchanged

break_it.what_happens: Calling the gate with None could raise
break_it.how: _eligibility_excluded_forms returns an empty set when lat or lng is None

post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief for a lot inside a dual-occupancy prohibition area and confirm the ceiling no longer shows dual_occupancy. P2 will add the station/catchment correctness and wire the 776 low/mid-rise exclusion against the LMR uplift; P3 unifies the fetch paths and the frontend onto this backend gate.
